events.title: As another week of heat settles in, Duke Energy rate hike heads back before regulators
events.summary: Duke Energy is returning before state regulators to defend its proposed rate hike amidst a week of high temperatures driving up cooling costs. The North Carolina Utilities Commission will begin evidentiary hearings for Duke Energy Progress's rate case, which includes a proposed settlement reducing the original rate increase request by more than half, potentially leading to an average annual increase of 3.4% over two years. The hearings will also address who should bear the costs of electric grid upgrades for large new customers like data centers and how the company's recent strong profits factor into the rate increase justification.

articles.headline: As another week of heat settles in, Duke Energy rate hike heads back before regulators

events.title: Sempra — Owner of SDG&E — Made $800 Million in Profits 2nd Quarter — While 1 in 5 of Their Customers Are Behind Average of $500 in Bills
events.summary: Sempra, the parent company of SDG&E, reported nearly $800 million in profits for the second quarter of 2026, a significant increase from the previous year. This financial success comes as many San Diego utility customers struggle, with nearly one in five SDG&E customers behind an average of $500 on their bills. Environmental and community groups rallied against these high utility costs, calling on local and state leaders to intervene and address the affordability crisis.

articles.headline: Sempra — Owner of SDG&E — Made $800 Million in Profits 2nd Quarter — While 1 in 5 of Their Customers Are Behind Average of $500 in Bills

events.title: Teledyne Technologies Acquires Varex Imaging in $1.1 Billion Deal
events.summary: Teledyne Technologies is set to acquire Varex Imaging Corporation in an all-cash deal valued at approximately $1.1 billion. This acquisition aims to strengthen Teledyne’s position in advanced X-ray imaging technology, particularly in medical and industrial markets, by integrating Varex's complementary product lines without significant overlap. The transaction, unanimously approved by both boards, is expected to close in early 2027, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.

articles.headline: Teledyne Technologies Acquires Varex Imaging in $1.1 Billion Deal

events.title: HTZ Stock Slides As Lawsuits, Dilution And Delisting Collide
events.summary: Hertz Global Holdings Inc. (HTZ) stock has fallen over 4.6% due to mounting restructuring challenges, including a securities class action lawsuit alleging misrepresentation of liquidity and used-car market weakness. The company announced a $300M secured notes deal and share lending, while warning of soft used-car prices, which triggered a significant share-price drop and led to analyst downgrades. HTZ will also be removed from the S&P SmallCap 600, increasing selling pressure and creating a volatile trading environment.

events.title: Yum China Completes $1.2 Billion Acquisition Of Pizza Hut Brand In Mainland China
events.summary: Yum China Holdings has completed its $1.2 billion acquisition of the Pizza Hut brand ownership in Mainland China from Yum! Brands. This acquisition, announced on June 16, 2026, is expected to provide greater strategic flexibility, eliminate a 3% license fee, and significantly boost Pizza Hut's restaurant and operating profit margins, aiming for a payback period of two to three years for new stores. The company plans to accelerate new Pizza Hut openings to over 800 annually in 2027 and 2028, up from 600, and expects the deal to be accretive to diluted EPS.

articles.headline: Yum China Completes $1.2 Billion Acquisition Of Pizza Hut Brand In Mainland China

events.title: Halliburton, TechnipFMC, Antero Resources, APA Corporation, and Transocean Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know
events.summary: Shares of several energy companies including Halliburton, TechnipFMC, Antero Resources, APA Corporation, and Transocean rose significantly following a rebound in Brent crude prices. This surge is attributed to geopolitical risk premium remaining in oil prices after a UAE-vessel incident and a substantial drop in shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, along with potential Iranian legislation to ban "hostile" vessels. The market reaction indicates that traders are re-pricing supply-shock risk, boosting expected cash flows for E&P companies, though the long-term stability of Hormuz flows remains uncertain.

articles.headline: Halliburton, TechnipFMC, Antero Resources, APA Corporation, and Transocean Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know

events.title: Las proteínas animales tuvieron variaciones mixtas de precios en julio, según Bancolombia
events.summary: During July, animal protein prices showed mixed variations, with poultry and beef prices increasing by 1.48% and 0.54% respectively, while prepared meats and pork saw reductions. This data from Bancolombia's economic research unit highlights short-term trends impacting Colombia's Consumer Price Index (IPC) for food. The report also notes varied price changes in fruits and vegetables, and forecasts continued acceleration in processed and perishable food prices, with overall food inflation estimated at 0.59% for July.

articles.headline: Las proteínas animales tuvieron variaciones mixtas de precios en julio, según Bancolombia
